expected_response: Radar emits radio pulses and measures the time for reflections to return. Distance = (time × speed of light) / 2. Doppler shift reveals target velocity. Used in aviation, weather forecasting, and military applications.

text: What is the difference between prokaryotes and eukaryotes?
expected_response: Prokaryotes (bacteria, archaea) lack a membrane-bound nucleus; DNA floats in the cytoplasm. Eukaryotes (animals, plants, fungi) have a nucleus and organelles like mitochondria and endoplasmic reticulum. Eukaryotic cells are larger and more complex.

A compiler transforms source code into machine code through phases: lexing (tokens), parsing (syntax tree), semantic analysis (types), optimization, and code generation. The output is an executable binary the CPU can run directly.

text: What is CRISPR used for in medicine?
expected_response: CRISPR enables precise gene editing for treating genetic disorders (sickle cell disease, muscular dystrophy), engineering CAR-T cells for cancer therapy, and developing diagnostic tools. Clinical trials are underway for several conditions.

Tides are caused by the gravitational pull of the Moon and Sun on Earth's oceans. The Moon creates two bulges: one facing it (direct pull) and one opposite (centrifugal effect). As Earth rotates through these bulges, we experience two high tides daily.

text: What is the difference between TCP and UDP?
expected_response: TCP is connection-oriented: guarantees delivery, ordering, and error-checking via handshakes and acknowledgments. UDP is connectionless: faster but no delivery guarantee. Use TCP for web, email, files. Use UDP for streaming, gaming, DNS where speed beats reliability.

MRI uses a strong magnetic field to align hydrogen atoms in the body. Radio pulses disturb the alignment; as atoms relax back, they emit signals detected by sensors. Different tissues relax at different rates, creating detailed soft-tissue images without radiation.

text: What is the difference between an interpreter and a compiler?
expected_response: A compiler translates the entire program to machine code before execution (C, Rust). An interpreter executes source code line by line at runtime (Python, Ruby). Compiled code runs faster; interpreted code is easier to debug and more portable.

text: How does the ozone layer protect us?
expected_response: The ozone layer in the stratosphere absorbs most of the Sun's ultraviolet-B radiation, which causes skin cancer and cataracts. O₃ molecules absorb UV photons and break apart, then reform — a continuous cycle of absorption that shields life on Earth.

text: What is the halting problem in computer science?
expected_response: The halting problem asks whether a program will finish or run forever given an input. Alan Turing proved in 1936 that no general algorithm can solve this for all programs. It established a fundamental limit on what is computable.

text: How does a nuclear fusion reactor work?
expected_response: Fusion reactors heat hydrogen isotopes to plasma (100M+ °C) so nuclei overcome electrostatic repulsion and fuse, releasing energy. Magnetic confinement (tokamak) or inertial confinement (lasers) contain the plasma. Still experimental; net energy gain achieved in 2022.

The microbiome is the community of trillions of microorganisms (bacteria, fungi, viruses) living in and on the body. The gut microbiome alone weighs about 2 kg. It aids digestion, synthesizes vitamins, trains the immune system, and influences mood and metabolism.

text: How does fiber optic communication work?
expected_response: Fiber optics transmit data as pulses of light through thin glass strands via total internal reflection. Light bounces along the fiber's core, carrying data at near-light speed over long distances with minimal signal loss. Much faster than copper cables.

Earthquakes occur when stress builds along tectonic plate boundaries and is released as sudden slip along a fault. The rupture point is the focus (hypocenter); the point above on the surface is the epicenter. Seismic waves radiate outward from the focus.

text: What is the observer effect in quantum mechanics?
expected_response: In quantum mechanics, measuring a system inevitably disturbs it. A particle exists in superposition of states until measured, at which point the wave function collapses to a definite state. This isn't about consciousness — any physical interaction constitutes observation.

HTTPS uses TLS: client and server perform a handshake exchanging certificates and agreeing on encryption. Asymmetric crypto (RSA/ECDHE) establishes a shared secret, then symmetric crypto (AES) encrypts the actual data. The padlock icon means the connection is encrypted.

Epigenetics studies heritable changes in gene expression that don't alter the DNA sequence. Chemical modifications (methylation, histone acetylation) turn genes on or off. Environment, diet, and stress can cause epigenetic changes, some of which pass to offspring.

EVs use electric motors powered by lithium-ion battery packs. The motor converts electrical energy to rotational energy with near-instant torque. Regenerative braking recovers energy during deceleration. No tailpipe emissions; efficiency is about 3-4x that of combustion engines.

The Doppler effect is the change in frequency of a wave when the source and observer move relative to each other. Approaching sources are higher-pitched; receding sources are lower-pitched. Used in radar, astronomy (redshift), and medical ultrasound.

text: How does an operating system manage memory?
expected_response: The OS uses virtual memory to give each process its own address space. Pages map virtual to physical addresses via a page table. The MMU translates addresses in hardware. When RAM is full, less-used pages swap to disk. This isolates processes and prevents conflicts.

Ohm's law states V = IR: voltage equals current times resistance. Doubling resistance halves current for the same voltage. It describes the relationship in resistive circuits and is fundamental to electrical engineering.

An enzyme is a biological catalyst, usually a protein, that speeds up chemical reactions in cells without being consumed. Each enzyme has an active site shaped for specific substrates. Temperature and pH affect enzyme activity.

Oxidation is losing electrons; reduction is gaining electrons (remember OIL RIG). They always occur together in redox reactions. Rusting is oxidation of iron. Batteries work through controlled redox reactions.

A binary tree is a data structure where each node has at most two children (left and right). A binary search tree keeps elements ordered: left children are smaller, right are larger, enabling O(log n) search on balanced trees.

A load balancer distributes incoming network traffic across multiple servers to prevent overload on any single server. Common algorithms include round-robin, least connections, and IP hash. It improves availability and scalability.

The French Revolution (1789-1799) overthrew the monarchy and established a republic. Triggered by financial crisis and inequality, key events include the storming of the Bastille and the Reign of Terror. It spread ideas of liberty, equality, and popular sovereignty.

Volcanoes form where magma from the mantle reaches the surface: at divergent plate boundaries (mid-ocean ridges), convergent boundaries (subduction zones), or hotspots (like Hawaii). Magma composition determines eruption style.
